Method.Implementation:
set tsc= $$$ERROR("Grp Link Not found") set errorMsg = " Group Link Not found " _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId $$$TRACE( "-- Find GS Grp Link --" _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId _ ", Version: " _ version) WRITE !, "-- Find GS Interchge Link --" _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId _ ", Version: " _ version _ ", Mode: " _ mode _ ", Direction: " _ direction
&sql(DECLARE WPCursor CURSOR FOR select r.ID, r.name from IHC_TPManage.TRADELINKS r, IHC_TPManage.TPIDS gs1, IHC_TPManage.TPIDS gs2, IHC_TPManage.TRANSACTIONTYPES tr where r.GsSenderId = gs1.ID and r.GsReceiverId = gs2.ID and r.TRANSTYPE = tr.ID and gs1.TPID = :senderId and gs2.TPID = :receiverId and tr.VERSION = :version and r.Mode = :mode and r.Direction = :direction and r.Active = 1 ) &sql(OPEN WPCursor) if (SQLCODE'=0) RETURN tsc FOR { &sql(FETCH WPCursor into :id, :relNm) WRITE !, "ItfFind Group Link :SQLCODE: " _ SQLCODE if (SQLCODE = 0) { set errorMsg = " FOUND TP Link for GS: " _ relNm _", " _ senderId _", " _ receiverId _", " _ gsDocType _", " _ version set tpObj.GrpRelationID = id set tpObj.GRPRELATIONSHIPNAME = relNm set tsc= $$$OK QUIT } else { QUIT } } &sql(CLOSE WPCursor)
return tsc

Method.name: ItfFindInterchageLink
Method.Implementation:
set tsc= $$$ERROR("Interchange Link Not found") set errorMsg = " Interchange Link Not found: "_ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId _ ", Version: " _ version _ ", Mode: " _ mode _ ", Direction: " _ direction WRITE !, "-- Find ISA Interchge Link --" _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId _ ", Version: " _ version _ ", Mode: " _ mode _ ", Direction: " _ direction
&sql(DECLARE WPCursor CURSOR FOR select r.ID, r.name from IHC_TPManage.TRADELINKS r, IHC_TPManage.TPIDS t1, IHC_TPManage.TPIDS t2, IHC_TPManage.TRANSACTIONTYPES tr where r.IsaSenderId = t1.ID and r.IsaReceiverId = t2.ID and r.TRANSTYPE = tr.ID and t1.TPID = :senderId and t2.TPID = :receiverId and tr.VERSION = :version and r.Mode = :mode and r.Direction = :direction and r.Active = 1 ) &sql(OPEN WPCursor) if (SQLCODE'=0) RETURN tsc FOR { &sql(FETCH WPCursor into :id, :relNm) WRITE !, "ItfFind InterchageLink :SQLCODE: " _ SQLCODE if (SQLCODE = 0) { WRITE !, id _", :" _ relNm set errorMsg = " FOUND TRADELINK for ISA: " _ relNm _", " _ senderId _", " _ receiverId _", " _ docType _", " _ version
set tpObj.IsaRelationID = id set tpObj.ISARELATIONSHIPNAME = relNm set tsc= $$$OK QUIT } else { QUIT } } &sql(CLOSE WPCursor)
return tsc

Method.name: ItfFindTPIDS
Method.Implementation:
set tsc= $$$ERROR("TP Not found") set errorMsg = "; TP Not found: " _ tpid
&sql(DECLARE WPCursor CURSOR FOR SELECT NAME, TPID FROM IHC_TPManage.TPIDS where TPID= :tpid)
&sql(OPEN WPCursor) QUIT:(SQLCODE'=0) FOR { &sql(FETCH WPCursor into :tpNm, :TPIDSIP) QUIT:SQLCODE
set errorMsg = "; TP found: " _ tpNm _", " _ TPIDSIP set tsc= $$$OK } &sql(CLOSE WPCursor) WRITE !, "ItfFindTPIDS: " _ errorMsg return tsc

set tsc= $$$ERROR("Interchange Relation Not found") set onm = $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "EDIPAYER" set errorMsg = " Interchange Relation Not found: "_ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId _ ", Version: " _ version _ ", Mode: " _ mode _ ", Direction: " _ direction WRITE !, "-- Find ISA InterchgRelation --" _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId _ ", Version: " _ version _ ", Mode: " _ mode _ ", Direction: " _ direction
&sql(DECLARE WPCursor CURSOR FOR select r.ID, r.name from IHC_TPManage.TRADELINKS r, IHC_TPManage.TPIDS t1, IHC_TPManage.TPIDS t2, IHC_TPManage.TRANSACTIONTYPES tr where r.IsaSenderId = t1.ID and r.IsaReceiverId = t2.ID and r.TRANSTYPE = tr.ID and t1.TPID = :senderId and t2.TPID = :receiverId and tr.VERSION = :version and r.Mode = :mode and r.Direction = :direction AND tr.ID = r.TRANSTYPE and r.Active = 1 ) &sql(OPEN WPCursor) if (SQLCODE'=0) { WRITE !, "Open: " _ SQLCODE RETURN tsc } FOR { &sql(FETCH WPCursor into :id, :relNm) QUIT:SQLCODE WRITE !, id _", :" _ relNm set errorMsg = " FOUND relationship for ISA: " _ relNm _", " _ senderId _", " _ receiverId _", " _ version
set lnkInfo = id _"," _ relNm set tsc= $$$OK } &sql(CLOSE WPCursor) set $NAMESPACE = onm return tsc
